title: This thing is great! It heats the water quickly
text: This thing is great! It heats the water quickly. This heats water quickly and it turns from black to red when the water is hot.  I would prefer if it had a spout that closes and opens with a push of a button.  I love using this for tea, it heats so quickly.

product_metadata.title: New House Kitchen Color Changing Electric Kettle with Rapid Boil Feature BPA Free Interior, Fast Heating Water Boiler, Auto-Shutoff, 1.7 Liter/1.8 Quart, Stainless Steel/Black/Red,
features: RED HOT: This 1. 7 Liter kettle changes from black to red when boiling so you always know when the water is hot. This feature makes the kettle stand out on any counter!

QUICK BOIL: Boils water quicker than traditional methods like stovetop kettles. It’s perfect for boiling water for tea, coffee, instant oatmeal and more. This kettle shuts off automatically once water reaches a boil.

CLARITY: No more spills or not filling with enough water. The transparent viewing window offers clearly indicated measurements so you can monitor how much water is in the kettle at any time. Once you’re done using, its cord wraps and stores underneath the base for extra convenience.

360 ROTATING BASE: 360-swivel base allows kettle to be lifted off and returned to its base with ease from all directions. The kettle can be filled and poured without the hassle of a power cord getting tangled or caught.
PURCHASE WORRY FREE: For your convenience, a 1 year hassle-free assurance is provided by New House Kitchen. 120 Volts.
description: The New House Kitchen Color Changing Electric Kettle makes everything about boiling water crystal clear. It’s intelligently designed to transition from black to red, so you know the second your water is hot and ready to be poured. Boils water quicker than traditional stovetop tea kettles and is perfect for tea, coffee, oatmeal, soup and more. No worries about whether you’ve shut off the kettle - it has an auto-shutoff feature built for added safety. Conveniently separates from swivel base for cordless pouring, so you can serve your loved ones more easily and not have to fill up the kettle at the sink with the hassle of a power cord. Boiling water has never been so colorful!
